design_tone: High-density, precision B2B recruitment CRM with role-based scoping, tactile clarity, and crisp visual hierarchy

rules: Never use pure #000000 or full transparent dropdown menus.
Dropdowns, select overlays, popovers, and sticky headers MUST use a solid or semi-opaque background (e.g., bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 with backdrop-blur-md).
Contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for badges/labels.
Role scope badge colors: Admin = Purple/Slate, Team Leader = Indigo/Blue, Recruiter = Emerald/Teal.

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Admin & Operational Data)
layout_and_spacing.alignment_rules: Left-align all data tables, input fields, forms, and headers. Center action buttons inside cards only if visually balanced.

role_scoping_rules.scope_switcher: Header shows current user active role badge and scope context badge (e.g. 'Scope: My Pipeline' vs 'Scope: Team East' vs 'Scope: Organization Wide')

ADMIN.access: Full access to Users, Roles & Permissions Matrix, Audit Logs, Org Settings, All Leads/Jobs/Clients

TEAM_LEAD.access: Team scope: View & manage team members, assign leads/tasks, view team audit logs & metrics

RECRUITER.access: Self scope: View & manage personal leads, tasks, followups, applications

login_and_password_reset.layout: Two-column split screen: Left branding artwork & key statistics callout, Right clean high-contrast auth card
login_and_password_reset.features: Login form, Forgot password view, Role selector hint, Password reset trigger toast

dashboard_shell.layout: Fixed left dark navigation bar + sticky light/dark glass header + high-density main content area

user_management.layout: Header with 'Add User' modal button + Filter Bar (Search, Role filter, Status active/inactive) + Data Table + Scope statistics cards
user_management.features: User table with avatar, role badge, department, assigned team leader, status toggle switch, edit/deactivate action menu

roles_and_permissions.layout: Role Selector Tabs / List on left + Granular Permission Matrix Grid on right
roles_and_permissions.matrix: Grouped by module (Users, Leads, Audit Logs, Settings) x Actions (Create, Read, Update, Delete, Export, Assign)

audit_log_viewer.layout: Filter toolbar (Date range, User, Action type, Severity level, Search query) + Expandable Chronological Audit Timeline Table
audit_log_viewer.features: IP address, timestamp, actor role, JSON payload diff modal preview, export CSV button

component_guidelines.tables: Dense rows, sticky header, hover bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50, explicit column widths, action drop-down menus
component_guidelines.dialogs_and_modals: Radix UI / Shadcn Dialog with backdrop overlay bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm, clear header & footer actions
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toast system with explicit success/error/warning icons and high-contrast text
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with hover opacity transition and focus-ring. Primary = Kinetic Indigo, Secondary = Slate outlines.

testing_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive and key data elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Build full React JS client components (using .js extension as configured in React project).
Implement mock API services with realistic state persistence for Auth, Users, Roles, Permissions, Audit Logs, and Scope switching.
Ensure complete responsive layout for mobile and desktop viewports.
Strictly follow data-testid naming conventions on all form fields, buttons, nav items, and table rows.
Make sure navigation active items and scoped breadcrumbs dynamically reflect current role (Admin / Team Lead / Recruiter).
Use standard Radix UI / Shadcn primitives already installed in node_modules, ensuring popovers/dropdowns have non-transparent solid/blur backgrounds.
